style: traditional Indian miniature painting, Pahari and Rajput style, fine brushwork, warm saffron, indigo and gold palette, soft light, devotional mood, no text, no letters
note: Each scene starts at a doha group: group 0 = opening shlokas, group g = chaupais g.x and doha g. Image files go in images/sundar/ as WebP under 200 KB.

scenes.title: मंगलाचरण · Invocation
scenes.prompt: Lord Rama seated in serene meditation on a lotus throne, blue complexion, bow resting beside him, Hanuman kneeling in devotion, golden halo, palace pillars

scenes.title: हनुमान जी की विदा · Hanuman sets out
scenes.prompt: Hanuman bowing with folded hands to Jambavan, Angad and the vanara army on a seashore at dawn, then leaping from a mountain that sinks beneath his feet

scenes.title: सुरसा की परीक्षा · Surasa's test
scenes.prompt: Giant serpent mother Surasa rising from the ocean with an enormous open mouth, tiny Hanuman flying out of it, gods watching from the clouds

scenes.title: लंका का दर्शन · First sight of Lanka
scenes.prompt: Hanuman standing on a mountain peak gazing at the golden fortress city of Lanka across the sea, gardens and lakes, bees around flowering trees

scenes.title: लंकिनी · Lankini at the gate
scenes.prompt: Hanuman in a tiny form at the night gate of Lanka striking the demoness guard Lankini, moonlit golden walls

scenes.title: विभीषण से भेंट · Meeting Vibhishan
scenes.prompt: Hanuman disguised as a Brahmin meeting Vibhishan at dawn outside a modest house marked with Rama's name and a tulsi plant, in the middle of the demon city

scenes.title: अशोक वाटिका · Sita in Ashok Vatika
scenes.prompt: Sita seated sorrowfully under an ashoka tree in a night garden, guarded by demonesses, Hanuman hidden among the leaves above

scenes.title: रावण का भय दिखाना · Ravana threatens Sita
scenes.prompt: Ten-headed Ravana with a raised sword before Sita who holds a blade of grass between them, queen Mandodari restraining him, Ashok garden at night

scenes.title: त्रिजटा का स्वप्न · Trijata's dream
scenes.prompt: Kind demoness Trijata telling her dream to the other guards around Sita, dream vision of a monkey burning Lanka shown in clouds

scenes.title: मुद्रिका · Rama's ring
scenes.prompt: Hanuman dropping Rama's golden signet ring into Sita's lap from the ashoka tree, Sita looking up in wonder

scenes.title: सीता जी को आश्वासन · Hanuman before Sita
scenes.prompt: Hanuman kneeling with folded hands before Sita, showing his huge golden form behind him like a mountain, Sita blessing him

scenes.title: वाटिका विध्वंस · The garden destroyed
scenes.prompt: Hanuman uprooting trees in Ravana's garden and fighting demon guards, prince Akshay Kumar charging with soldiers

scenes.title: ब्रह्मास्त्र बंधन · Bound by Meghnad
scenes.prompt: Meghnad on a chariot releasing the Brahmastra, Hanuman respectfully allowing himself to be bound with glowing divine ropes

scenes.title: रावण सभा · In Ravana's court
scenes.prompt: Bound Hanuman calmly advising ten-headed Ravana seated on a high jewelled throne amid courtiers in a golden hall

scenes.title: लंका दहन · Lanka in flames
scenes.prompt: Hanuman with a blazing tail leaping across the rooftops of golden Lanka, palaces on fire, Vibhishan's house untouched

scenes.title: चूड़ामणि · Sita's jewel
scenes.prompt: Sita giving her crest jewel chudamani to Hanuman under the ashoka tree, Hanuman receiving it reverently in both hands

scenes.title: मधुवन · Return and rejoicing
scenes.prompt: Joyful vanaras eating honey and fruit in the Madhuvan grove, Angad and Hanuman leading them toward Sugriva

scenes.title: प्रभु से मिलन · Hanuman before Rama
scenes.prompt: Rama embracing Hanuman with tears of love while Lakshman, Sugriva and the vanara army watch, chudamani glowing in Rama's hand

scenes.title: सेना प्रस्थान · The army marches
scenes.prompt: Vast army of vanaras and bears marching toward the southern sea behind Rama and Lakshman, banners, mountains in the distance

scenes.title: मंदोदरी और विभीषण की सीख · Counsel ignored
scenes.prompt: Vibhishan pleading with folded hands before Ravana in the court, Ravana kicking him away in anger, Mandodari watching worried

scenes.title: विभीषण शरणागति · Vibhishan takes refuge
scenes.prompt: Vibhishan falling at Rama's feet on the seashore, Rama lifting and embracing him and anointing him with sea water as king of Lanka

scenes.title: शुक का संदेश · The spies and the letter
scenes.prompt: Ravana's spy Shuka in disguise among the vanaras, then delivering Lakshman's letter to Ravana in his court

scenes.title: समुद्र का समर्पण · The ocean submits
scenes.prompt: Rama fitting a blazing arrow to his bow on the seashore, the Ocean god rising from the waves with folded hands and offerings of jewels
